mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and a temperature of 72 degrees at Reddan Soccer Park, with a moderate air quality rating.

The Verona Police Department has arrested 34-year-old Halla Nelson for sexual assault of a child by a school staff member, with the investigation stemming from a 2019 incident. Also, construction updates are in effect for the Aldi development on Highway M, where traffic patterns will shift and lane closures continue through early September.

We have a busy weekend ahead with the Dane County Farmers Market taking place today, and live music hosted at Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee starting this coming Monday.
On Friday, September 4, the Verona Police Department booked a Madison teacher into the Dane County Jail regarding an inappropriate relationship with a student from 2019.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Mint Cookie. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and grab a scoop.
